title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Four Bar Positions
intuition: Four discrete spatial bar locations (two vertical, two horizontal) on 8x8 grayscale images. Exposes cross-valley barycentric mode collapse on convolutional generators when batch/particle coupling is soft.
failure_mode: Historically a major discriminator: BCAP, BISPF, EMPF-v8, and RHBI-v12 collapsed to 2/4 bars or blurry superpositions.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 held image task and Four Laws Adherence Law 2 anchor (600 updates).
